answer: At random, unannounced moments, summon each identity to a brief live exchange that turns on the previous reply, with only minutes to answer in its own words — a horizon too short to script fifty masks. A single operator cannot genuinely attend that many simultaneous conversations, so a farm's answers arrive late, identically worded, or not at all, leaving a violet plume of correlated silence. A jade signal marks each summons, so no mask can claim it missed the call. Honest agents simply show up; occasional absence is excused, but simultaneous no-shows expose the one hand behind many names.
